title: 2023 Panini Prizm #367 Jaren Hall Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Get your hands on this Jaren Hall 2023 Panini Prizm #367 sports trading card, featuring the rookie player from the Minnesota Vikings. This standard-sized card is a must-have for any NFL fan and collector. 

With its Prizm parallel/variety, this card stands out from the base set and showcases Hall's talent in a unique way. Don't miss out on the chance to add this card to your collection, whether you're a die-hard Vikings fan or simply a fan of football.
